scripts.dev: bun run kill-dev-ports && concurrently "bun run emulators" "bun run wait-emulators && bun run seed && bun run app"
scripts.app: cd apps/client && dotenv -e ../../.env -- bun run start
scripts.app:ios: cd apps/client && dotenv -e ../../.env -- bun run ios
scripts.app:android: cd apps/client && dotenv -e ../../.env -- bun run android
scripts.emulators: cd backend/firebase && dotenv -e ../../.env -- sh -c 'bunx firebase emulators:start --project "$FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID" --import=./emulator_data --export-on-exit=./emulator_data'
scripts.test: bun run test:client && bun run test:backend:unit && bun run test:backend && bun run e2e:web
scripts.test:backend: bun run kill-test-ports backend && cd backend/firebase && bunx firebase emulators:exec --project hero-stack-local --config firebase.backend.json --only auth,firestore,functions "cd functions && FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:9399 FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:8280 FUNCTIONS_EMULATOR_PORT=5021 bun run test:integration"
scripts.e2e:web: bun run kill-test-ports e2e && cd backend/firebase && bunx firebase emulators:exec --project hero-stack-local --config firebase.e2e.json --only auth,firestore,functions "cd ../.. && FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:9199 FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:8180 FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=hero-stack-local bun run seed && E2E_EMULATOR_AUTH_HOST=127.0.0.1:9199 E2E_EMULATOR_FUNCTIONS_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5011/hero-stack-local/us-central1 bunx playwright test"
scripts.e2e:ios:maestro: bun run kill-test-ports e2e && cd backend/firebase && bunx firebase emulators:exec --project hero-stack-local --config firebase.e2e.json --only auth,firestore,functions "cd ../.. && FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:9199 FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:8180 FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=hero-stack-local bun run seed && cd apps/client && EXPO_PUBLIC_USE_EMULATOR=true EXPO_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=hero-stack-local EXPO_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_API_KEY=demo-key EXPO_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN=hero-stack-local.firebaseapp.com EXPO_PUBLIC_AUTH_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:9199 EXPO_PUBLIC_FUNCTIONS_URL=http://localhost:5011/hero-stack-local/us-central1 bun run maestro:test:ios"
scripts.ci: bun run check:client:ui && bun run check:pw:console && bun run check:expo && bun run test && bun run check:web
